{{Quote|And we now know why Mitth'raw'nuruodo believed Sidious&mdash;because the Chiss had already encountered the Vong at Vun'Hanna and the Twilight Void.|From ''Mitth'raw'nuruodo Reconsidered: A Patriot's Perspective'', by Lenang O'Pali|<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
'''Vun'Hanna''' was a location in [[Realspace/Legends|space]],<ref name="EGtW" /> situated within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point by [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="date">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], establishes that the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] have already [[Battle between the Chiss and Yuuzhan Vong|fought]] the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the events of the novel take place.</ref> it was the site of an encounter between the military forces of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] and [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="EGtW" /> that resulted in a [[Battle between the Chiss and Yuuzhan Vong|battle]], in which the Chiss were victorious.<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref> In the year [[55 ABY]], the author [[Lenang O'Pali/Legends|Lenang O'Pali]] mentioned the encounter at Vun'Hanna in the publication ''[[Mitth'raw'nuruodo Reconsidered: A Patriot's Perspective]]''.<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vun'Hanna was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]],<ref name="EGtW" /> and was placed in grid square D-7 by the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EAOC" />
